description: Defines classes and functions related to kernel execution in PyTorch's native runtime, including Arguments management, OpKernel interface, and operator handling.

classes.name: Arguments
classes.description: Encapsulates static and dynamic arguments for kernel execution.

classes.name: OpKernel
classes.description: Abstract interface for executing a node in the computation graph.

methods.name: getOperatorForTarget
methods.description: Retrieves an operator handle for a given target and node.

methods.name: Arguments::getDynamicArgs
methods.description: Returns pairs of indices and dynamic argument pointers.

methods.name: Arguments::findDynamic
methods.description: Finds a dynamic argument by index.

methods.name: Arguments::getStatic
methods.description: Retrieves a static argument by index.

methods.name: Arguments::getStackWithStaticArgs
methods.description: Returns the stack of static arguments.

methods.name: OpKernel::hasPrimKernel
methods.description: Checks if the kernel is a primitive kernel.

methods.name: OpKernel::hasStaticDispatch
methods.description: Checks if the kernel uses static dispatch.
